name: Being Holy
overview: Scripture calls God's people to be holy because God Himself is holy, emphasizing this in multiple commands to the children of Israel to sanctify themselves and avoid defilement (Leviticus 11:44-45; 19:2). Holiness is rooted in God's character and His redemptive work in bringing Israel out of Egypt, setting a standard for His people to reflect His purity. The heavenly declaration of God's holiness in Isaiah 6:3 underscores the fullness of His glory, while the call to rejoice in the Lord (Philippians 4:4) reminds believers to find joy in their relationship with the holy God they serve.
